text:
```yaml
name: Verify setup-zig action is pinned

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-pinned-action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify setup-zig action is pinned
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          files=(
            .github/workflows/rust-ci.yml
            .github/workflows/rust-release.yml
            .github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml
          )
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" "$file"; then
              echo "❌ $file does not contain the pinned setup-zig action."
              exit 1
            fi
            if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@v2" "$file"; then
              echo "❌ $file still contains the unpinned setup-zig action."
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All workflow files contain the pinned setup-zig action."
```
